EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION NOTICE
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: BD/WM/ESD (2)/ UO/ACQ/13. Land Ministry No.: 4/3/9/2013/IR/58. I, hereby give notice notify under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendments) Act, No. 28 of 1964, the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: In the Province of Uva, District of Badulla, Divisional Secretariat of Welimada in the minor Division of Dambawini Palatha Korale, Village Mirahawaththa, Survey General F.V.P. 63 Paper No. 19 of Supplement 12 and dated on 27.10.2017 Base plot Lot Number 537– 552. The total Extent of 1.9147 Hectares the details follows:
